question:
**Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Fabulously
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Fantastically**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fabulously**: In an extremely positive or extraordinary manner, often related to something being wonderful or marvellous. (अत्यंत सकारात्मक या असाधारण तरीके से, अक्सर किसी चीज़ के अद्भुत या अद्भुत होने से संबंधित होता है)

 
 
• **For example**: *The party was decorated fabulously, with sparkling lights and elegant decor.*
 
 
 
• **Fantastically**: In an incredibly impressive or imaginative manner, often used to describe something as amazing or unreal. (अविश्वसनीय रूप से प्रभावशाली या कल्पनाशील तरीके से, अक्सर किसी चीज़ को आश्चर्यजनक या अवास्तविक के रूप में वर्णित किया जाता है)
 
 
• **For example**: *The magician performed his tricks fantastically, leaving the audience in awe.*
 
 
 
• So, "fabulously" means in a wonderful or amazing manner, and "fantastically" also means in an imaginative or incredible way, making it a synonym.

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• "**Scarcely**" means barely or hardly. (मुश्किल से)
 
• "**Scantily**" means in a limited or insufficient manner. (सीमित या अपर्याप्त तरीके से)
 
• "**Nominally**" means that something is done or exists in name or form only. (कुछ किया गया है या केवल नाम या रूप में मौजूद है)
